This inventory contains commands marked as implemented in the runtime action manifest. Audacity-derived entries are reviewed against Audacity 4.0.0-beta.2+ at [`908ad0a526e5`](https://github.com/audacity/audacity/tree/908ad0a526e5bfdab68de780e893cebe172d27eb/src). Local entries are identified separately.

Product availability follows each product profile’s command filters. “—” means that no default shortcut is assigned; it does not mean the command is unavailable.
